story.text: 왜 그렇게 서 있어요. 안 들어가요?
story.reading: wae geu-reoh-ge seo iss-eo-yo. an deul-eo-ga-yo?
story.en: Why are you just standing there. Aren't you coming in?

story.text: '한복' 입어보기로 했잖아요. 저기 사장님이 골라주실 거예요.
story.reading: 'han-bok' ib-eo-bo-gi-ro haess-jan-a-yo. jeo-gi sa-jang-nim-i gol-la-ju-sil geo-ye-yo.
story.en: We agreed you'd try on a 'hanbok'. The owner over there will pick one for you.

story.text: 이 '사진관', 오래된 곳이에요. 옛날 사진처럼 나온대요.
story.reading: i 'sa-jin-gwan', o-rae-doen gos-i-e-yo. yen-nal sa-jin-cheo-reom na-on-dae-yo.
story.en: This 'photo studio' is an old place. They say the photos come out like old-fashioned ones.

story.text: '거울' 앞에서 뭘 그렇게 봐요. …잘 어울려요, 그 색.
story.reading: 'geo-ul' ap-e-seo mwol geu-reoh-ge bwa-yo. …jal eo-ul-lyeo-yo, geu saek.
story.en: What are you looking at so much in the 'mirror'. ...It suits you, that color.

story.text: 그 '색깔' 저고리, 잘 골랐네요. …나쁘지 않다고요, 진심으로.
story.reading: geu 'saek-kkal' jeo-go-ri, jal gol-lass-ne-yo. …na-ppeu-ji anh-da-go-yo, jin-sim-eu-ro.
story.en: That 'color' jeogori, you picked well. ...I mean it, it's not bad at all.

story.text: 사실… 먼저 말 거는 거, 저한테는 '용기'가 좀 필요했어요.
story.reading: sa-sil… meon-jeo mal geo-neun geo, jeo-han-te-neun 'yong-gi'ga jom pil-yo-haess-eo-yo.
story.en: Honestly... speaking to you first took a bit of 'courage' for me.

story.text: …뭘 그렇게 봐요. 사진이나 찍으러 가요, 시간 없어요. …내일은, 진짜 할 말 있어요.
story.reading: …mwol geu-reoh-ge bwa-yo. sa-jin-i-na jjig-eu-reo ga-yo, si-gan eobs-eo-yo. …nae-il-eun, jin-jja hal mal iss-eo-yo.
story.en: ...What are you staring at. Let's go take a photo, we don't have much time. ...Tomorrow, I really do have something to say.

words.example_en: I wear a hanbok and take a photo.
This photo studio is very old.
I look in the mirror while getting dressed.
I gathered the courage to speak up.

sentences.en: I go to the photo studio wearing hanbok.
I try on the hanbok in front of the mirror.
Which color hanbok do you like?
I gathered courage and spoke to you first.
The two of us are reflected in the photo studio's mirror.
